* Ike3gppN1ModeUtils contains functions needed to support 3GPP-specific N1 Mode functionality. * *

This class is package-private.

methods.name: static IkeNotifyPayload generateN1ModeCapabilityPayload(byte pduSessionId)
methods.comment:
* Generate N1 Mode Capability Notify payload. * *

This method formats the given PDU Session ID to its payload format. * * @see TS 124 302 Section 8.2.9.15 for specification of N1_MODE_CAPABILITY Notify payload. * @param pduSessionId the PDU Session ID to be included in this N1 Mode Capability payload * @return the formatted N1_MODE_CAPABILITY Notify payload data as a byte array.

methods.name: static byte[] getSnssaiFromNotifyData(byte[] notifyData) throws InvalidSyntaxException
methods.comment:
* Get the S-NSSAI value from the specified Notify Data.
     *
     * @see TS 124 302 Section 8.2.9.16 for specification of N1_MODE_INFORMATION Notify payload.
     * @param notifyData The Notify-Data payload from which the S-NSSAI value will be parsed.
     * @return the parsed S-NSSAI value

methodNames: static byte[] getSnssaiFromNotifyData(byte[] notifyData) throws InvalidSyntaxException
